results.text: Is carvedilol superior to propranolol in patients with cirrhosis with portal hypertension: a systematic and meta-analysis. Carvedilol has shown greater potency than propranolol as a β-blocker in managing cardiac conditions. However, its efficacy in reducing portal hypertension (PHTN) in patients with cirrhosis remains unclear. While studies have demonstrated carvedilol's superiority in reducing portal pressure compared to propranolol, limited real-world data directly compare their efficacy in preventing decompensation.
